It should be helpful to make the pairings exclusive so that people don’t accidentally mess up other people’s light.

reviews.title: not good.
reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible quality. I’ve had these lights for only 8 months and barely use them—around 6 hours a week—and they’re already basically useless. They constantly glitch, and now EVERY SINGLE COLOR has stopped working except one ugly green. I can’t change the color, adjust anything, or even use the lights the way they’re supposed to work. I’m literally stuck with GREEN.

Now I have to rip down an entire room’s worth of LED lights and replace everything because they couldn’t even last ONE YEAR. They seem great for the first couple of months, but don’t let that fool you. They clearly are not built to last. A complete waste of money and an even bigger waste of time. if i could rate this lower then a one star i would. i am very upset i wasn’t expecting to go through the hassle of changing them again before the 2 year mark. Unacceptable.
